name: GalaxEye & Bellatrix — India's Satellite Propulsion Industry

fields.YouTube title: India’s Private Space Industry: Propulsion for 30 Satellites
fields.YouTube description (includes hashtags):
Indian space companies GalaxEye and Bellatrix Aerospace are building a domestic supply chain for satellite technology.

On 24 November 2026, GalaxEye awarded Bellatrix Aerospace a multi-year contract to supply ARKA electric propulsion systems for 30 planned Drishti Gen-II Earth observation satellites. Electric propulsion uses electrical energy to accelerate charged particles, enabling efficient in-space manoeuvres.

In January 2024, ISRO confirmed the completion of an ARKA 200 propulsion experiment aboard its POEM-3 orbital platform. GalaxEye's planned satellites combine optical and synthetic aperture radar imaging to provide complementary observations, including radar imaging at night and through clouds.

The order covers future satellites, not a constellation already in operation. The contract value has not been disclosed.
